about: Where uaRO differs from its base game data. Item data follows Hercules pre-renewal by default; the lists below override it. Edit this file by hand (see CONTRIBUTING.md). Each entry needs the item's itemId and name exactly as in loot.json.

modifiedSellPrices.about: uaRO lowered these NPC sell prices. The price is the most an NPC pays: Overcharge does NOT raise it.

customSellValues.about: NPC sell prices checked by hand for uaRO, where the emulators are wrong or unsure (including items confirmed to sell for 0z). This is the base price: Overcharge applies on top, like normal items.

npcShops.about: Which items NPCs sell (npcBuyable in loot.json), filled in by `npm run sync:shops`. By default that's every item in a zeny shop in Hercules' pre-renewal NPC scripts. The lists below add uaRO's renewal shops and its differences.

renewalShops.about: Renewal NPC shops uaRO added, read from rAthena: every zeny shop on these maps, plus any shops listed by name (shops that other NPCs open). Once a shop is checked in game, put it in uaroShops instead.

uaroShops.about: NPC shops checked in game on uaRO. Every item listed here is sold by NPCs. `price` is the shop's normal price in zeny (before Discount). Items don't need to be in loot.json. Not shown on the site yet.

renewalContent.about: Renewal areas uaRO added. Drops here may be tweaked by uaRO, so they are NOT added automatically. `npm run sync:prices` only checks the prices of items dropped here against rAthena's renewal data and lists differences for review. When they differ, the pre-renewal price is used.

reviewedPrices.about: Renewal-area items whose renewal price differs, already reviewed: they keep their pre-renewal price. The sync stops listing these.
